data.title: 玛修 · 常夏海滩
data.description: 【玛修 · 常夏海滩】常夏之岛的海滩上，玛修披着白色连体泳装的薄纱下摆，小心翼翼地踩过浪花，粉色短发被海风吹得飞起，她回头露出一个清爽的笑——「前辈，海水比想象中还要凉快呢！」
data.action: 穿白色连体挂颈泳装，在浅浪中小心迈步，回头清爽微笑
data.camera: full-body side view, walking feet and shallow wave edge visible
data.promptProse: Mash carefully steps barefoot through the shallow surf and turns back with a fresh delighted smile, her opaque white halter one-piece and light dress-like hem secure above the wavelets. Sea wind lifts short pink-lavender hair, preserving the covered right eye and visible violet eye. The full-body side view follows the waterline behind her. Clear sunlight illuminates the hem and small breaking wave, while wet sand reflects soft light beneath her feet.
promptTokens: opaque white one piece halter swimsuit
